_meta.doc: A/B experiment registry. Loaded by static/js/experiments.js. Each experiment has an id, status (active|paused|draft), and variants whose traffic must sum to 100. Bucketing is deterministic on (te_uid, experiment_id) — same user always gets the same variant for a given experiment, but bucketing across experiments is independent.
